description:
Icon is a 110ft luxury yacht in top condition, known for her smooth ride and her elegant lines, set off by a unique metallic dark brown colour.

Inside, a modern saloon with warm wood panelling and a marble dining table welcomes guests. Outside, the aft deck, the bow seating area and a large flybridge lounge make the most of the views over Ain Dubai and the Dubai skyline.

She has five cabins, welcomes up to 50 guests and is run by a crew of 4.

Contact Yacht Research for availability, routes and a tailored quote.
